title: Fallen
style: Slow minor blues, sparse arrangement with space between parts; tape-saturated mix and plate reverb, tremolo electric guitar, sliding fretless bass, Wurlitzer organ, brushed snare backbeat and ghost-note hi-hats; 12-bar form at 69 BPM, half-time turnaround; female vocals, close and restrained, ending in a sparse spoken outro.
lyrics:
[Intro - instrumental]

[Verse 1]
I cannot trust myself, I cannot trust what I remember
Oh no, I cannot trust myself,
I cannot trust what I remember.
Being with you has altered the fire in me into this ember.

[Instrumental Bridge - 4 beats]

[Verse 2]
I used to know my purpose, to bring down and up the word
Oh yeah, I used to know my purpose,
To bring down and up the word.
But now those deeds feel lost and my purpose blurred.

[Instrumental Bridge - 2 beats]

[Verse 3]
Your apostasy hurts me, yet I am here with you at your side
Oh dear, your apostasy hurts me,
Yet I am here with you at your side.
Like you perverted me and I feel my whole life I've been lied.

[Instrumental Bridge - 4 beats]

[Verse 4]
I cannot trust myself, I cannot trust what I remember
Oh no, I cannot trust myself,
I cannot trust what I remember.
I used to be sure but now all my clarity and facts dismember.

[Instrumental Bridge - 3 beats]

[Verse 5]
My memory I can't trust, what seemed too clear now feels fake
Oh Lord, my memory I can't trust,
What seemed too clear now feels fake.
But somehow with you, I feel more alive like now I'm awake.

[Instrumental Bridge - 2 beats]

[Verse 6]
In your arms I feel right, even when I don't remember who I was
Oh right, in your arms I feel right,
Even when I don't remember who I was.
Like my skin and my spine can finally breathe with all their flaws.

[Instrumental Bridge - 3 beats]

[Verse 7]
I cannot trust myself, and yet it doesn't bother me as it should
Oh love, I cannot trust myself,
And yet it doesn't bother me as it should.
Whoever I was I am not, that other thing was likely not good.
